en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, from Zareeh, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When you are free from performing your rituals, return, for it would be more desirous for you to the returning’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from those whom he has mentioned from Dharih from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When you complete your nusuk (acts of ‘Umrah and or Hajj) go back; it leaves you with more desire to return to Makkah.’”
